description: The live web data engine for teams and agents: Search API, Extract API and Deep Search.
rules: Authenticate each call with the header Authorization: Bearer <key>. The examples take the key from the SPECSTREAM_API_KEY environment variable.
The account owner creates an API key under Agents & API at https://specstream.ai/workspace.
Search API: GET https://api.specstream.ai/v1/web-search?q=<the question>. Write q in everyday words, 1 to 2,000 characters.
Extract API: POST https://api.specstream.ai/v1/extract with the JSON body {"urls": ["<url>"], "format": "markdown"}. Send 1 to 20 http or https URLs.
Every reply of the Search API and the Extract API is a JSON object with one key: {"data": {...}} when the call succeeds, {"error": {"code", "message", "details"}} when it stops.
Search results are in data.sources, each with url, title, site and snippet. data.answer can be null: then read data.rows and data.sources.
Extract results are in data.results, one item for each URL in the order sent, each with url, status and text. Use the text only when status is ok.
SDK calls: web_search(q=...) and extract_pages({...}) in Python (specstream-client), webSearch({ q }) and extractPages({ urls }) in TypeScript (@specstream/sdk).
The MCP server is https://api.specstream.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Its tool search_web calls the Search API and read_pages calls the Extract API.
On 503 with a Retry-After header, wait that many seconds and send the call again. Nothing is charged.
